quantize_model_autoround_format: quantize a model using AutoRound with configurable bits, group_size, and symmetry settings
quantize_model_mixed_precision: quantize a model with per-layer mixed precision configuration using layer_config parameter
quantize_model_awq_backend: quantize and save a model in auto_round:auto_awq format for AWQ backend inference
load_quantized_model_tritonv2: load a pre-quantized model using AutoRoundConfig with tritonv2 backend for inference
quantize_model_fp8_block: quantize a model using FP8_BLOCK scheme and save in fp8 format with block-wise scaling
